'''0.18c''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that adjusted the maximum height an avatar can reach and fixed some issues.

==Changelog==
* Launcher now loads correctly even if http site is not available
* Maximum height which can be reached by moving characters has been changed

===Bug fixes===
* Fixed stalls in memory which were the cause of most re-syncs
